_doc: Effect-composition tables. An action node (HireMercenaries, SpawnUnit, GrantImmigrant, ...) reads its concrete breakdown from here instead of a hardcoded C++ list -- so every effect is named, labeled, editable data, not a black-box verb. Unit names resolve to a type id through the @UNIT reference table (row index == type id). Count rolls are byte-verified (see each _source); the composition (which unit types, carrier, veteran) is the data.

mercenary_wartime.label: King's Intervention (wartime mercenaries)
mercenary_wartime.note: Exactly ONE of cat1 (Cont. Cav.) / cat3 (Artillery) is set by a coin flip; cat0 count = roll(2,(4-diff)/2+2). Every land unit is a Veteran, delivered by a Man-O-War.
mercenary_wartime._source: spec/systems/mercenary.md -- VICEROY.EXE func_03C4A2 (per-cat type by revolution flag) + func_03D510 (force landing) + func_03E442 (wartime offer). BYTE_VERIFIED.

mercenary_peacetime.label: Foreign veteran offer (peacetime mercenaries)
mercenary_peacetime.note: cat0 count = roll(1,3); a coin: heads -> +1 Dragoon and NO artillery; tails -> 1-2 Veteran Artillery (cat3). cat1 (A-flag) is always 0 in peacetime. Every land unit is a Veteran, delivered by a Man-O-War.
mercenary_peacetime._source: spec/systems/mercenary.md -- VICEROY.EXE func_03C4A2 + func_03D510 + func_03E664 (peacetime offer, K=4). BYTE_VERIFIED.

mercenary_intervention.label: Free foreign intervention (AI/default force)
mercenary_intervention.note: The AI/default per-category types from func_03C4A2 when neither the wartime nor human-foreign branch is taken: Regulars/Cavalry/Artillery.
